visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with glasses and a white t-shirt talks to the camera while sitting next to a large, fluffy white Samoyed dog. His hands are frequently petting the dog's head and neck. The background is a brightly lit indoor closet area filled with hanging white garments. (2) Transition to a close-up of the man's hand stroking the dog's thick white fur. The dog's eyes are half-closed, appearing calm and stationary. The man's facial expressions are highly animated and expressive as he explains the dog's refusal to use the bathroom. (3) The scene changes to an indoor tiled hallway. The man, now wearing a brown jacket over his t-shirt, presents a bright orange dog raincoat. He kneels on the floor and attempts to fit the orange coat onto the large dog. (4) The dog playfully tries to move away and escape the dressing process, leading to a physical struggle. The man uses both hands to pull and secure the orange fabric around the dog's torso. The indoor hallway lighting is warm and bright. (5) The dog is finally dressed in the orange raincoat, which includes a clear plastic protective hood over its head. The man laughs joyfully at the dog's appearance, petting the plastic hood while the dog looks slightly confused. (6) Exterior night scene in a park or garden. The dog, wearing the bright orange coat, walks on wet green grass under artificial night lighting. Rain streaks are clearly visible against the dark background. The dog eventually squats to relieve itself. (7) The man appears briefly in the frame, holding a black umbrella over himself and the camera. His face reflects a sense of relief. He then films the dog finishing its business on the grass while the rain continues to fall. (8) Back indoors near an entryway, the man is seen unfastening the wet orange raincoat from the dog's body. The dog shakes its body to dry off. The scene ends with a close-up of the man's tired but satisfied facial expression.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy, upbeat electronic BGM plays with a bright synthesizer melody and a steady rhythmic beat. A male voice speaks rapidly with high arousal and a friendly, animated tone describing his dog's bathroom habits. The recording environment is quiet with low room tone. (2) Audible fabric and plastic crinkling sounds occur as the raincoat is handled. Several digital 'pop' and 'whoosh' sound effects are inserted as text graphics appear on the screen. The male voice remains excited and expressive throughout the dressing struggle. (3) The acoustic profile shifts to an outdoor setting with a noticeable broadband noise floor of falling rain and wind. The male voice increases in volume and intensity to remain clear above the environmental noise. Short comic SFX mark successful moments in the task. (4) Returning to indoor acoustics, the rain noise disappears, replaced by the sound of raincoat buttons and rustling fabric as it is removed. The BGM maintains its tempo until a final synthesized flourish as the video concludes.
